name: analytics-dashboard
title: Analytics Dashboard
description: A complete SaaS analytics dashboard: KPI strip, revenue area chart, acquisition, conversion funnel, cohort retention heatmap, filterable customer table, and activity feed — plus the app shell (sidebar, mobile navigation, theme toggle) and typed mock data.
docs: Import "honestui/charts.css" once in your global stylesheet (before tailwindcss) so the charts are styled. The dashboard installs under app/(dashboard)/ — visit /dashboard. Dark mode: add suppressHydrationWarning to <html> in your root layout (the theme is applied on the client). Mock data lives in lib/dashboard/data.ts; replace it with your own data access. A ready-to-clone template of this dashboard lives at https://github.com/honestui/honestui-dashboard.
